Name: Slime Hutch Winery Redux
Author: MadModderJess
Description:
This mod replaces the vanilla Slime Hutch with a rustic stone winery, for those uninterested in slime ranching and who want a dedicated keg and cask space.

This is an expansion and re-release of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2709/]Slime Hutch Winery for Content Patcher[/url], which was compiled and released by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/43737222]andiluxe[/url] and which includes work by many others including [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/dentrala.54852/]Dentrala[/url] and [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/sheetcakeghost.643042/]sheetcakeghost[/url]/[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/7016937]serenityfrost[/url]. I was given permission by andiluxe to repost it and take over maintenance on it. :3

It has all of that version's options, including three interior color palettes and nine interior layout options; this expansion also has eighteen different exterior colors in both seasonal and non-seasonal variants, as well as exteriors previously available. Pixels have been cleaned up to remove inconsistencies and make the bricking/woodwork look more natural. The exterior and interior can now be enabled or disabled separately, allowing better compatibility with other mods.

[size=4]Updates:[/size]
1.1.0 - 04/04/21
-image files and coding completely redone to reduce file size
﻿-white stone and dark wood added as options
﻿-wood color, vat color, and other options now individually configurable
﻿-new vat cover and vat steps colors
﻿-fixed missing hanging plants in spring and summer overlays for seasonal signposts
﻿-changed shadowing color to match base game better
﻿-various pixel fixes
﻿-new reference images for better clarity

[size=4]Install:[/size]
﻿1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
﻿2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
﻿3. Unzip this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
﻿4. Run the game to generate the config file, then close the game again; open the config.json using Notepad or a similar text editor.
﻿5. Change config options (reference images included in download, instructions in the ReadMe), save the config file, and run SV again. Enjoy!

[b][color=#cc0000]IMPORTANT[/color][/b]: If you are updating from version 1.0.0 to version 1.1.0, make sure you DELETE the existing mod folder before replacing it with the new version. You will need to redo your config file completely, as the mod is now set up differently, so there's no need to save the old one.

[size=4]Notes:[/size]
﻿- [b][u]All options for this mod are DISABLED by default in the configuration file[/u][/b]. You MUST edit the config.json (after generating it, as noted in the install instructions) to choose your preferred options in order for anything to show up in the game. Please use the reference images included in the download, in conjunction with the ReadMe, to help you decide. The images are not scaled, and are examples of exactly what will be shown in the game if the correct options are chosen.

﻿﻿- Not all configurable options will work with every exterior style.

﻿- Anything else that changes the exterior or interior of the Slime Hutch [b]WILL[/b] conflict unless properly configured; either disable the exterior/interior in this mod's options, or disable it in the conflicting mod's options. If two exteriors or two interiors are set to load at the same time from different mods, neither one will do so properly, or possibly at all. If the exterior or interior does not load or loads wrong somehow, please check for conflicts first.

﻿-It's possible that other mods' config.json files may interfere with this mod if those config files also change the Slime Hutch, even if their options/assets are disabled. You may need to test this by temporarily removing the conflicting mod's config.json file and seeing if my mod loads correctly. If you find a mod that refuses to play nicely with this one even though the respective config options shouldn't conflict, let me know, and I'll see if I can figure out a patch for it.

﻿- Placing casks in the winery requires a mod that allows casks to be functional outside the farmhouse cellar. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] is currently recommended; [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642/]Custom Cask Mod[/url] looks promising but I have not personally tested it yet. Check SMAPI's mod page ([url=https://smapi.io/mods]https://smapi.io/mods[/url]) for other mods that might serve this function.

This is my first published SV mod, so please feel free to alert me of errors!
